source_type: Freesound public HQ MP3 previews of real hardware/foley recordings
scope: Recorded physical proxies. No AIM/RMUC hardware capture or synthetic synthesis.
common_processing: FFmpeg decode, mono fold-down, resample at 24000 Hz, trim, mean removal and peak normalize. Transients use short start/end fades; loops use cosine crossfade and seamless start-point rotation.
